 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 10-07-2025 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, the learned counsel for the State and the learned counsel for the SVU.

2. This is an application on behalf of the petitioner for quashing of the First Information Report against the petitioner instituted against the petitioner in connection with SVU Police Station Case No.02/2021 (Special Case No.48/2021) instituted under Section 120B, 420, 409 I.P.C. as well as Section 12 read with Section 13(2) r/w Section 13(1)(b) of the Prevention of Corruption Act without any specific allegation made against the petitioner as well as not mentioning the specific defalcation made by the petitioner.
